title: A very long chain fatty acid responsive transcription factor, MYB93, regulates lateral root development in Arabidopsis.
authors: Uemura, Yuta; Kimura, Saori; Ohta, Tomomichi; Suzuki, Takamasa; Mase, Kosuke; Kato, Hiroyuki; Sakaoka, Satomi; Uefune, Masayoshi; Komine, Yuki; Hotta, Kazuhiro; Shimizu, Motoyuki; Morikami, Atsushi; Tsukagoshi, Hironaka
journal: The Plant journal : for cell and molecular biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究拟南芥中VLCFA响应转录因子MYB93调控侧根发育，虽涉及转录因子和深度学习分析LRP分期，但核心是植物发育生物学而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法仅用于图像分期而非TF-DNA结合预测或互作机制研究。
abstract: Lateral roots (LRs) are critical to root system architecture development in plants. Although the molecular mechanisms by which auxin regulates LR development have been extensively studied, several additional regulatory systems are hypothesized to be involved. Recently, the regulatory role of very long chain fatty acids (VLCFAs) has been shown in LR development. Our analysis showed that LTPG1 and LTPG2, transporters of VLCFAs, are specifically expressed in the developing LR primordium (LRP), while the number of LRs is reduced in the ltpg1/ltpg2 double mutant. Moreover, late LRP development was hindered when the VLCFA levels were reduced by the VLCFA synthesis enzyme mutant, kcs1-5. However, the details of the regulatory mechanisms of LR development controlled by VLCFAs remain unknown. In this study, we propose a novel method to analyze the LRP development stages with high temporal resolution using a deep neural network and identify a VLCFA-responsive transcription factor, MYB93, via transcriptome analysis of kcs1-5. MYB93 showed a carbon chain length-specific expression response following treatment of VLCFAs. Furthermore, myb93 transcriptome analysis suggested that MYB93 regulated the expression of cell wall organization genes. In addition, we also found that LTPG1 and LTPG2 are involved in LR development through the formation of root cap cuticle, which is different from transcriptional regulation by VLCFAs. Our results suggest that VLCFA is a regulator of LRP development through transcription factor-mediated regulation of gene expression and the transportation of VLCFAs is also involved in LR development through root cap cuticle formation.
abstract_zh: 侧根（LRs）对植物根系结构发育至关重要。尽管生长素调控侧根发育的分子机制已被广泛研究，但推测仍有多个额外的调控系统参与其中。近期，极长链脂肪酸（VLCFAs）在侧根发育中的调控作用已被揭示。我们的分析表明，VLCFAs的转运蛋白LTPG1和LTPG2在发育中的侧根原基（LRP）中特异性表达，而ltpg1/ltpg2双突变体中侧根数量减少。此外，当通过VLCFA合成酶突变体kcs1-5降低VLCFA水平时，晚期LRP发育受到阻碍。然而，VLCFAs调控侧根发育的具体机制细节仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们提出了一种利用深度神经网络以高时间分辨率分析LRP发育阶段的新方法，并通过kcs1-5的转录组分析鉴定了一个响应VLCFA的转录因子MYB93。MYB93在VLCFA处理后表现出碳链长度特异性的表达响应。此外，myb93转录组分析表明，MYB93调控了细胞壁组织基因的表达。同时，我们还发现LTPG1和LTPG2通过根冠角质层的形成参与侧根发育，这与VLCFAs的转录调控不同。我们的结果表明，VLCFA通过转录因子介导的基因表达调控来调节LRP发育，而VLCFAs的转运也通过根冠角质层形成参与侧根发育。
